verdict.rationale: USPTO's online filing systems (Trademark Center, Patent Center, Financial Manager) store user submissions and payment data, so asking about data residency is a fair privacy question. Nothing in the evidence shows any user-selectable storage region or residency option. The only storage-related mention is card information kept in Financial Manager, which says nothing about location choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
